Docs.summary: Metadata for a single conversation item's audio segment. For bring-your-own-storage (BYOS), the response includes `blob_uri`, a direct customer-storage URI without a SAS token, that the customer accesses with their own credentials. For Foundry-managed storage, `blob_uri` is absent and the bytes are streamed through the item's `/audio/content` route.
